cards.subject: a calm, soft Japandi room for a child aged 3 to 5, with a round wool rug and a small wooden toy hot-air balloon
cards.scene: A bright airy room with a light oak floor. A large round natural oat wool rug lies on the floor with one small wooden toy hot-air balloon and a few wooden blocks on it. On the RIGHT side wall, away from the mural: a low solid-oak bench (35 cm high) with two picture books, and above it one small framed line drawing. Warm morning sunbeams from a window on the RIGHT lie in soft patches on the floor. A boy of about four in a soft oat knit sweater and light grey trousers stands on the floor in the middle of the room about two metres in front of the mural wall with his back to the camera, one arm raised and pointing up at the big balloon, his head tilted back to look up at it, his face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, well away from the mural. Palette: oat, pale oak, soft sage and white.
cards.framing: Shot from the left part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the RIGHT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.

cards.subject: a playful circus-inspired room for a school-age kid (6 to 10 years) with a striped arch-fronted bench
cards.scene: A bright room with a warm oak floor. A large round cream wool rug lies on the floor with nothing on it. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a low arch-fronted cream bench (40 cm high) with a brick-red and cream striped cushion, and above it one small framed vintage circus poster. Warm golden hour sunlight from a window on the LEFT lies in long soft patches across the floor. A sheer cream linen curtain hangs at the extreme right edge of the frame, close to the camera and slightly out of focus, as a foreground layer. Palette: caramel, cream, warm oak and white.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at natural eye level, turned about 30 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, from its near edge to the far corner, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part. Nothing stands in front of the mural.

clips.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. A boy of about four in a soft oat knit sweater and light grey trousers stands with his back to the camera in front of the mural wall, his right arm already raised and pointing up at the big balloon, his head tilted back looking up at it. Slowly and calmly he takes one small step toward the wall while his arm stays raised and keeps pointing at the big balloon and his gaze stays on it. His body moves very little. Only the back of his head, his hair and his clothes are seen, and his head stays turned toward the wall. The rug, the toys and the room stay exactly as they are. The light stays constant.
clips.items: round wool rug, wooden toy balloon, wooden blocks, oak bench with a folded linen throw, picture books, picture frame and architecture

clips.motion: A smooth, steady first-person walk-in at a clearly visible calm walking pace: the camera moves forward about one and a half metres into the room at natural eye level and drifts a little to the right as it goes, with no tilt and no rotation, giving a strong soft depth parallax (the nearer objects shift clearly more than the farther ones). The sheer cream curtain in the extreme foreground on the right leaves the frame as the camera advances past it. Soft dappled shadows of leafy branches sway slowly on the wall and on the floor, as in a light breeze: only the shadows move, subtly and low in contrast, and they never change the colours or the drawing of the mural.
clips.items: cream wool rug, arch-fronted bench, striped cushion, picture frame and architecture
